listing.name: Marathon (Aleph One)
listing.summary: Marathon uses its complete official Aleph One Windows package. Shared player profiles remain upstream-owned.

steps.title: Play the complete official game package
steps.instruction: The complete official Windows package includes this game’s scenario data and native player; no separately supplied commercial original, ROM or setup helper is required. Keep all package companions. This route pins release-20260930; automatic updates are not offered. Explicit Play can read and update an existing shared upstream profile. Core does not adopt that profile. Do not copy legacy Prefs or other old-runtime files into this fresh package. This route starts this bundled game; use a separate upstream copy for custom scenarios or extra data-search paths. Upstream owns shared profiles in Documents/AlephOne (saves, quick saves, recordings, screenshots and logs) and LocalAppData/AlephOne (preferences). Existing legacy Prefs in a separately owned upstream copy remain external. Core manages this separate runtime only; its backups do not include those external profiles. Preserve the creating runtime and actual profile before upstream replacement or older-runtime use; no save/state conversion, populated profile adoption or gameplay compatibility is inferred.

warnings: Core backups exclude upstream-owned Aleph One profiles. This pinned runtime does not offer automatic updates.
Use a short Windows output folder. Core checks packaged-file path lengths before publication and Play; this runtime cannot use every long installation path.
